payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the previous state of the art in the context of the AI2 WinoGrande Challenge, identifying RoBERTa as the model that was surpassed by T5.

claims.text: The previous state of the art in the AI2 WinoGrande Challenge was based on the RoBERTa model, which is an encoder-only transformer architecture.
The T5 model achieved a performance improvement over the previous state of the art by over five points, indicating a significant advancement in the task.
